sloka: श्रीस् त्वाम् भजति शोकघ्नी रक्षसाम् भयम् आगतम् ।रामात् कमल पत्र अक्षि दैत्यानाम् इव वासवात् ।। ६-३३-३०
transliteration: śrīs tvām bhajati śokaghnī rakṣasām bhayam āgatam ।rāmāt kamala patra akṣi daityānām iva vāsavāt ।। 6-33-30

translations.english: "Your fire of anger will be gone. Your husband, the lotuspetal eyed Rama whose prowess is inconceivable like that of Indra who vanquished Daityas will come and kill Ravana and win you back."
